summary_md:
# “AI-trejden är halvdöd”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this EFN Morgon episode the hosts say the AI trade is 'half-dead': Nasdaq fell, Nvidia dropped 6%, Anthropic traded below its IPO price, and the bond market is getting tired of AI. Meanwhile US consumer stocks and healthcare are strong. In Sweden the focus is on Elekta's strong Q report (orders beat, China turning, heavily shorted stock) and Ratos selling Plantagen at a large loss. The hosts are sceptical of Ratos and positive on Sobi's momentum.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EKTA-B — Elekta | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong Q: margin 14% vs expectations, orders beat, China back to growth. Low valuation and high short interest point to a possible big move up today.

#### Reasoning

Hosts call it a very strong report. Organic growth is 5%, adjusted margin is 14% (helped about 1pp by tariff refunds) and orders beat, with China turning after three negative quarters. Low valuation plus heavy short interest could trigger a squeeze, and healthcare sentiment is positive. Ture says it looks interesting if growth gets going. This is not an explicit buy call, so conviction is moderate.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order growth fades in coming quarters
- if margin beat proves to be driven mainly by one-off tariff refunds
- if China recovery reverses

> *"Nej men värderingen är ju ganska låg och det är en väldigt blankad aktie ska man komma ihåg."*

---

### ⛔ RATO-B — Ratos | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host Ture is sceptical despite colleague Martin Blomgren's buy call. Other serial acquirers and investment companies offer the same industrial exposure.

#### Reasoning

The Plantagen sale is called a 'disaster deal' (about a 1bn loss). Focusing on infrastructure and industry is not a unique niche, and Ratos has a problematic history. The spin-off Sentia outperforming once it left Ratos is seen as a bad sign. Possible upside triggers are the move to NAV reporting and a cheap valuation. The EFN colleague's view is buy, so views are mixed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if NAV reporting reveals large discount to underlying values
- if Oase divestment completes and the company proves itself as a pure industrial holding

> *"Så jag ställer mig lite frågande till varför man ska köpa ett Ratu som ju har en så här problematisk historik."*

---

### 🟠 SOBI — Sobi | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

RBC Outperform, joins OMXS30 on 1 Dec. Host compares it with Insmed (acquired for $41bn) and its specialty drug portfolio, a possible M&A angle.

#### Reasoning

Host finds Sobi interesting because it resembles Insmed, which Sanofi just bought as big pharma fills its patent cliff. RBC resumes coverage at Outperform (analyst view), and OMXS30 inclusion adds index-flow momentum. The host's view is interest rather than an explicit buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if pharma M&A appetite cools
- if index-inclusion momentum fades after 1 December

> *"Tycker också att Sobi är lite intressant som är ganska, tycker jag, verkar ganska likt Insmed, med en stor portfölj av spännande specialistläkemedel."*

---
